message.content: The lowercase comment style with square-bracket annotations (e.g., `## [:read config##` or `[ word ]`) serves two purposes: it creates a consistent, machine-parsable format for the Perl-based multi-agent system to parse module headers and special syntax, and it enforces a uniform stylistic convention across the codebase. The lowercase requirement ensures predictable, case-insensitive pattern matching for automated tools, while the square-bracket notation (rather than parentheses or braces) provides a distinct, unambiguous delimiter that can be reliably extracted by the P7 infrastructure — the `##` prefix marks module metadata, and `[ word ]` brackets mark bracket annotations used for type hints or semantic labels.
